title: ROS Pipeline Benchmark Result
description: Machine-readable report from collect_ros_metrics.py. Contains per-frame timing records and aggregate statistics for the ROS pipeline overhead over a benchmark run.

metadata.description: System, model, engine, token-budget, and ROS configuration metadata.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the report was generated.

engine_config.description: Contents of the engine config.json, if present.

warmup_frames.description: Number of leading frames excluded from timing statistics.

measured_frames.description: Number of frames included in timing statistics.

aggregate.description: Aggregate statistics across measured frames (warmup excluded).

cold_start_ms.description: Time from node start to first frame dequeued (ms). Null when session_start record is absent.

frames.description: Per-frame timing records (all frames including warmup).

timing_stats.description: Statistical summary for a timing metric.

image_stamp_ns.description: ROS image message header timestamp in nanoseconds.

dequeue_wall_ns.description: Monotonic wall-clock nanoseconds when frame was dequeued from the bounded queue.

convert_done_ns.description: Monotonic wall-clock nanoseconds after image format conversion and optional resize.

infer_done_ns.description: Monotonic wall-clock nanoseconds after backend infer() returned (IPC round-trip complete).

publish_done_ns.description: Monotonic wall-clock nanoseconds after ROS result message published.

inference_ms.description: Native engine inference time in milliseconds, derived from inference_seconds reported by the TensorRT worker. NOT recomputed by this repository.

image_convert_ms.description: Time for image format conversion + optional resize (ms).

ipc_overhead_ms.description: IPC socket serialization overhead: total IPC round-trip minus native inference time (ms).

publication_ms.description: Time from IPC response received to ROS message published (ms).

ros_overhead_ms.description: Total ROS pipeline overhead: image_convert_ms + ipc_overhead_ms + publication_ms (ms).

total_worker_ms.description: Total worker time: from frame dequeue to result published (ms).

success.description: Whether inference succeeded for this frame.

error.description: Error message if success is false, empty string otherwise.

dropped_before.description: Cumulative dropped-frame count at the time this frame was dequeued.
